Opened at original 800×600. The bounded editorial-page root fallback is intact: brand, media/CTA fragments and beige stage render without decoding corruption. The large partial crop is expected because the affected selector did not resolve; it remains mismatch evidence, not a visual acceptance claim.

Opened at original 759×600. The production Exhibitions heading, counters, tabs and topic controls are crisp and legible; no blank frame, tearing or capture corruption is present. This remains mismatch evidence for the unresolved selector/cascade.

Opened at original 800×600. The home hero, navigation and poster edge render coherently; the bounded viewport crop is intentional and no capture corruption is visible. The record remains mismatch evidence because the exact affected selector was absent.

Opened at original 759×600. The lab Exhibitions heading, counters, tabs and topics render clearly with no blank or corrupted capture. It is retained only as the terminal mismatch view for the unresolved selector/cascade.

Opened at original 560×600. The compact home hero, CTA buttons and lower artwork are fully legible and uncorrupted. The image truthfully records the root fallback while the listing-filter selector is absent.

Opened at original 800×600. The desktop home navigation, hero title and poster edge render without tearing or missing font blocks. The bounded root view is valid mismatch evidence for an unresolved hover selector, not a PASS.

Opened at original 800×140. The participants rail and visible card contents are sharp; the left/right edge truncation is the intentional bounded horizontal crop. No capture corruption was observed; cascade mismatch remains recorded.

Opened at original 800×600. The large beige editorial stage with partial brand/breadcrumb/medallion is a valid bounded root fallback, not an empty-file failure. Its sparse framing is retained as truthful mismatch evidence because the bento target did not resolve.

Opened at original resolution. The Like control is visible, unobscured and has a clear turquoise focus-visible ring; adjacent text/card crop is intact. This visually corroborates the keyboard packet without asserting Home/End semantics.

Opened at original resolution. The focused rail/card viewport is visible and unobscured; the subtle outer focus boundary is present at the rail edge and the card content is intact. No capture corruption was observed.
